PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 2004
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 1 OF 2004
GOVERNOR'S PENSION
(AMENDMENT) ORDER 2004
An Order further
to amend the Governor's Pension Order, 1974)
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th January, 2004]
No.F.2(2)/2004-Pub., dated 13-1-2004.-----The
following Order promulgated by the President is hereby published for general
information:--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Governor's Pension Order, 1974 (P.O. No.3 of 1974), for the
purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (3) of Article 101 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following
Order:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Order may be called the Governor's Pension
(Amendment) Order, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 2,
P.O. No.3 of 1974.--In the Governor's Pension Order, 1974 (P.O.No.3 of
1974), hereinafter referred to as the said Order, in Article 2, in clause (1),
for the words "five thousand" the words "ten thousand"
shall be substituted.
3. Amendment of the Schedule,
P.O. No.3 of 1974.--In the said Order, in the Schedule, in Serial No.3, for
the figure "1000" the figure "3000" shall be substituted.
